name: The New Springs
summary: Krakle's claim sends you to Winterspring to speak with Donova Snowden. Her answer will confirm whether what he told you is true.

sections.title: A Word in Winterspring
sections.body: Krakle points you toward Donova Snowden in Winterspring. You go to her to learn whether his claim is true; her answer is still to come.

faq.answer: You speak with Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

faq.q: Why am I going to Winterspring?
faq.answer: Krakle told you something, and Donova Snowden can confirm whether it is true.

aliases: what happens when I talk to her
faq.answer: She confirms that what Krakle told you is true.

attribution: In-game quest text: The New Springs
